data.title: bn-1m6c: examples/chatter, a deep-stream chat corpus that rolls segments
data.description: New workspace member examples/chatter: a chat/feed corpus generator and reader whose channel streams get deep enough to roll and seal segments, the shape examples/social structurally cannot produce (bn-3jqg measured social at 1.007 events/stream with no segment-size knob). Adds a --segment-bytes knob, --seal-pack on/off, --scale demo/large/huge presets, a deterministic seeded generator with lognormal 100-800 byte payloads, a per-channel plus bounded global-timeline projection with a discardable checkpoint sidecar and a byte-compare rebuild proof, scroll-back paging backward through sealed history, a tailer written directly against read_global_page so both SUB2 rules are visible, and a chatter bench subcommand emitting five process-timed cells as JSON. Measured in release: demo scale is 32466 events / 12.5 MiB / 11 sealed segments in 0.30s; large scale is 5.43M events / 1.9 GiB / 27 sealed segments in 28.5s. Full suite 1323 passed (1257 before, 66 new). Workspace epoch f4951e1c42159663983d02660474354a296a6812, HEAD 693e1d0a20bf5d93e8b21c1f9bce00c077ba608a.
